 October 24, 2026 2 min read PN By Pascal Ndegwa - Reporter UK, October 24 ,2026 - Manchester City travel to Villa Park this afternoon with a perfect record and the pressure that comes with it. Seven wins from seven have put them three points clear at the top of the Premier League. Aston Villa, currently 12th, have the chance to become the first side to take points off them this season.
 City manager Enzo Maresca confirmed that Erling Haaland is fully fit and available. The striker has been the main reason for City’s flying start and remains their biggest threat. Antoine Semenyo is the only confirmed absentee. A few other players face late fitness checks after the midweek Champions League game.
 Villa are missing key players of their own, including Amadou Onana and Aaron Wan-Bissaka. Their in-form midfielder Johan Manzambi is a doubt. Manager Unai Emery knows this is a rare chance to damage the league leaders on home soil.
 The timing adds extra weight. The Ballon d’Or ceremony takes place in London on Monday. Strong performances this weekend will be the last chance for players to push their case before the awards are handed out.
 For City, the challenge is clear. Keep the winning run going against a side that will sit deep and look for moments on the break. For Villa, it is about organisation, energy, and taking any chance that comes their way.
